race.comment: PLAYING QUEST (3) went back early from his wide draw over 1200m at Carnarvon last time but hit the line strongly to finish fourth. Suited here and expected to prove tough to stop. HIT THE JACKPOT (1) pushed forward and went on to record a determined win last start by 2.5 lengths over 1300m at Port Hedland. Will take advantage of the good draw. This looks a sterner test than last time but on his best form he is good enough to take this out. IMPERIALIZE (2) led from a wide gate last time over 1300m at Port Hedland but felt the pinch and faded out of it. Has good early speed so should take up a forward position. Will give backers a great sight. PERCUSSION PRINCE (9) made progress last time out, finishing 4.5 lengths from the winner in third at the end of 1300m at Port Hedland. Another forward showing is anticipated. CROWS (10) is better than he showed last time out and can bounce back.
